definitions.explanation: The collective opinion or attitude of the general public on a particular issue. Composed of 世 (world, society) + 論 (opinion, argument). Originally read せろん, but よろん has become the dominant modern reading.

examples.japanese: {世論|よろん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A public opinion poll was conducted.

examples.japanese: {世論|よろん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to gain the support of public opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世論|よろん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The government decided to review the policy after facing public backlash.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
This word has two accepted readings: よろん (modern standard) and せろん (traditional). Both are correct and widely used. News broadcasts tend to use よろん. The entry for the せろん reading is listed separately.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世論|よろん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (public opinion poll/survey)
- {世論|よろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧ (to sway public opinion)
- {世論|よろん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧ (public support)
- {世論|よろん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ (public backlash)
- {世論|よろん}⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧ (shaping of public opinion)
